communication_goal: 提出成长目标，并约定可执行的练习和复盘时间。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure colleagues have a supportive one-to-one conversation at a small round table. The developer on the left gestures thoughtfully and has an open paper notebook directly in front of them, with two blank ruled pages and clear binding; a pen lies beside it without covering the pages. The mentor on the right wears simple glasses and gives an encouraging open-hand gesture. Keep the whole notebook visible and separate from one small mug at the right. No text or speech balloons.
